timing: recorded after static implementation review and before any v2.7 outcome run
reason: make the runtime/training boundary and fail-closed mechanics machine-auditable without changing the preregistered model, feature set, utility, threshold grid, or promotion objective

clarifications.runtime_surface: action construction, features, within-turn winner, chronological latch, and composition use a label-free runtime surface/API; isolated outcome labels are attached only afterward for cached training and metrics
clarifications.fold_integrity: family_index must map to exactly one outer fold and one inner fold; fold values must cover 0..4 and every outer-by-inner cell must be nonempty
clarifications.fit_readiness: both heads must have two classes and each fit must include at least five distinct rescue-positive sessions and five distinct rescue-positive product families; otherwise the effective action is KEEP
clarifications.weights: deduplicated action weights must be finite, nonnegative, sum to one across all turn/action rows of every active session, and remain zero for sessions without actions
clarifications.metric_safety: the existing nondegradation gates are checked both at official six-decimal reporting precision and on unrounded reciprocal-rank/first-hit-turn means with 1e-12 numerical tolerance
clarifications.effective_quantile: if readiness fails, the serialized effective quantile and threshold are KEEP; any safe inner proposal is retained only as a diagnostic proposed_quantile
clarifications.policy_membership: an activated supplemental choice must be a currently available deduplicated candidate for that same session and turn
clarifications.input_binding: feature count/order, action width, seed, C, solver, max_iter, utility multiplier, quantile grid, frozen hashes, and readiness minima are checked against the committed preregistration before evaluation
clarifications.posthoc_invariant: the already-recorded v2.6 union oracle remains report-only and must reproduce 20 sessions, fold counts [9,2,7,1,1], and HR ceiling 0.9815; it never filters runtime actions or model rows
